title: Make route title fallback preserve actual page titles
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that buildRouteTitleFallback ignores pathname and returns Health - instance; timer/navigation/head-mutation hooks can overwrite valid route PageTitle values. HealthStats also hard-codes the instance name. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/wwwroot/memorysmith.js and Components/Pages/HealthStats.razor. Make fallback conditional and route-aware, then add route title regression coverage.
